name: Manhole
description: Cast-iron manhole covers set in the pavement, each cast with its own tread of studs, squares, rings, ribs or bars around a round boss.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --m: @p(@var(--mdots), @var(--msquares), @var(--mrings), @var(--mribs), @var(--mbars)); background: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, @p(var(--color1), var(--color2)) 92%, transparent 92%); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 12%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @var(--m); mask: @var(--m); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 39%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 60%, transparent 60% 78%, #000 78%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 60%, transparent 60% 78%, #000 78%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --mdots: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 58%, transparent 58%) 0 0 / 14.2857% 14.2857%, linear-gradient(#000, #000); --msquares: linear-gradient(90deg, #000 70%, transparent 70%) 0 0 / 14.2857% 14.2857%, linear-gradient(180deg, #000 70%, transparent 70%) 0 0 / 14.2857% 14.2857%; --mrings: repeating-radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, #000 0 6%, transparent 6% 12%), linear-gradient(#000, #000); --mribs: conic-gradient(from 0deg at 50% 50%, #000 0deg 10.125deg, transparent 10.125deg 22.5deg, #000 22.5deg 32.625deg, transparent 32.625deg 45deg, #000 45deg 55.125deg, transparent 55.125deg 67.5deg, #000 67.5deg 77.625deg, transparent 77.625deg 90deg, #000 90deg 100.125deg, transparent 100.125deg 112.5deg, #000 112.5deg 122.625deg, transparent 122.625deg 135deg, #000 135deg 145.125deg, transparent 145.125deg 157.5deg, #000 157.5deg 167.625deg, transparent 167.625deg 180deg, #000 180deg 190.125deg, transparent 190.125deg 202.5deg, #000 202.5deg 212.625deg, transparent 212.625deg 225deg, #000 225deg 235.125deg, transparent 235.125deg 247.5deg, #000 247.5deg 257.625deg, transparent 257.625deg 270deg, #000 270deg 280.125deg, transparent 280.125deg 292.5deg, #000 292.5deg 302.625deg, transparent 302.625deg 315deg, #000 315deg 325.125deg, transparent 325.125deg 337.5deg, #000 337.5deg 347.625deg, transparent 347.625deg 360deg), linear-gradient(#000, #000); --mbars: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 6%, #000 6% 16%, transparent 16% 26%, #000 26% 36%, transparent 36% 46%, #000 46% 56%, transparent 56% 66%, #000 66% 76%, transparent 76% 86%, #000 86% 96%, transparent 96%), linear-gradient(#000, #000); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
